adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Threatened by the High Evolutionary, Ayesha hunts Rocket to Counter-Earth and sends Adam to seize him for her creator.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardian Ayesha must hand over to the High Evolutionary.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Hunts Rocket down for the High Evolutionary.
adds.evidence: The High Evolutionary orders Ayesha to bring him 89P13 (Rocket) or he will destroy the Sovereign; she tracks Gamora's ship to Counter-Earth and tells Adam they must capture Rocket first, and Adam goes after him at the Bowie.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: When the High Evolutionary takes Drax captive aboard Arête, Groot joins the Guardians' rescue and they fight side by side through the ship.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who helps rescue Drax from Arête.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Groot helps rescue from Arête.
adds.evidence: Drax, Nebula and Mantis are captured aboard Arête; the other Guardians, Groot among them, mount the rescue and battle the High Evolutionary's forces together.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Drax talks Mantis into chasing after Quill on Counter-Earth, and when they are caught aboard Arête she defends him to Nebula and tames three Abilisks to carry them out.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who defends Drax and tames the Abilisks to free him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who talks Mantis into chasing Quill.
adds.evidence: Drax tricks Mantis into pursuing Quill's group; aboard Arête Mantis defends Drax when Nebula berates him, and she calms three Abilisks which carry Drax, Nebula and Mantis out.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Quill leads the rescue when Drax is taken captive aboard Arête, then tells the team he is leaving them to go home to Earth.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The friend who leads the rescue from Arête, then leaves for Earth.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Quill rescues from Arête before leaving the team.
adds.evidence: Quill calls Kraglin to bring Knowhere so the Guardians can rescue Nebula, Drax and Mantis; afterwards Quill gathers the Guardians and announces he is returning to Earth.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Gamora flies in to pick up Quill and Groot after they leap from the rising Arête with Theel.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian Gamora picks up after he leaps from Arête.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager who picks Groot up after his leap from Arête.
adds.evidence: Quill and Groot jump off Arête with Theel, kill him for the override code, and are rescued by Gamora on their ship.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: On Counter-Earth Mantis stays behind with Gamora to guard the dying Rocket, until Drax talks her into going after Quill.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian who stays with Gamora to guard Rocket.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager Mantis guards Rocket with on Counter-Earth.
adds.evidence: At Counter-Earth Drax and Mantis remain with Gamora and Rocket; Drax tricks Mantis into pursuing Quill's group, leaving Gamora to fight War Pig and Adam.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Nebula radios Groot to bring the ship for the escape from the Orgoscope, then drives with him and Quill to the High Evolutionary's complex.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who radios Groot for the escape and rides with him to Arête.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Nebula calls for the escape and rides with to Arête.
adds.evidence: Escaping the Orgoscope, Nebula contacts Groot to pick them up in the Bowie; on Counter-Earth Nebula joins Quill and Groot to find Theel at Arête Laboratories.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Quill and Groot go into Arête together, then jump off the rising ship with Theel and take the override code that saves Rocket.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who goes into Arête with Groot and gets the code.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who leaps off Arête with Quill to get the code.
adds.evidence: Quill and Groot enter Arête, jump off the ship with Theel and retrieve the override code from his corpse, which Quill uses to restart Rocket's heart.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Kraglin's misfired arrow stabs Nebula on Knowhere, and later she radios him to lock Knowhere onto Arête so everyone can escape.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Kraglin stabs by mistake, who later radios him for the escape.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate whose arrow stabs Nebula, who locks Knowhere on for the escape.
adds.evidence: During target practice Kraglin fails to control the Yaka Arrow and stabs Nebula in the chest; later Nebula contacts him to interlock Knowhere with Arête so they can escape.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Quill leaves Kraglin in charge of Knowhere, then calls him to fly it to Arête and blast an opening for the rescue.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who leaves Kraglin in charge and calls him in for the rescue.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Quill leaves in charge of Knowhere and calls in for the rescue.
adds.evidence: Quill tells Kraglin and Cosmo they are in charge of Knowhere while the Guardians leave, and later contacts Kraglin to pilot Knowhere to Arête and blast a hole in the spaceport.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Mantis and Nebula are caught together aboard Arête, where Mantis calls Nebula out for always finding fault, then tames three Abilisks to free them.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis calls out, then frees with the Abilisks.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who calls Nebula out and frees her with the Abilisks.
adds.evidence: Aboard Arête Nebula insults Mantis, and Mantis says Nebula finds fault in everyone to make herself feel okay; captured in a pit, Mantis calms three Abilisks that carry Nebula, Drax and Mantis out.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Mantis stays on Counter-Earth to guard the dying Rocket, until Drax talks her into going after Quill.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis stays behind to guard.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who stays behind to guard Rocket.
adds.evidence: At Counter-Earth Drax and Mantis remain with Gamora and Rocket while Quill, Groot and Nebula go to Arête; Drax then tricks Mantis into pursuing Quill's group.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Martinex and Stakar are with the United Ravagers who help the Guardians into the Orgoscope, and they welcome Gamora back aboard afterwards.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: His captain. They welcome Gamora back to the Ravagers together.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Stakar's first mate in the United Ravagers.
adds.evidence: The United Ravagers board the Bowie and Stakar explains the Orgoscope plan; afterwards Martinex picks Gamora up from Knowhere and Stakar embraces her and says 'Welcome home.'

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Nebula keeps carrying the drunk, grieving Quill to bed on Knowhere, and he mistakes her for Gamora. She later stops Gamora from attacking him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Nebula looks after through his grief.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who carries Quill to bed and defends him.
adds.evidence: Nebula carries the drunk Quill to his room, where he thinks she is Gamora; Mantis tells her 'He's your brother'; when Gamora attacks Quill, Nebula stops her.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: When the High Evolutionary takes Mantis captive aboard Arête, Kraglin flies Knowhere in and blasts a way into the ship for the rescue.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Kraglin flies Knowhere in to rescue.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who flies Knowhere in to rescue Mantis.
adds.evidence: Quill tells Kraglin they need his help to save Nebula, Drax and Mantis from the High Evolutionary, and Kraglin pilots Knowhere to Arête and blasts a hole in it.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: Groot and Cosmo join the new Guardians under Rocket and charge together into a stampede to defend a settlement on Krylor.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow new Guardian on Rocket's team.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow new Guardian on Rocket's team.
adds.evidence: The new Guardians led by Rocket, including Groot, Cosmo, Kraglin, Adam, Phyla and Blurp, defend a settlement on Krylor from a stampede.

adds.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
adds.text: When the High Evolutionary takes Drax captive aboard Arête, Kraglin flies Knowhere in and blasts a way into the ship for the rescue.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who flies Knowhere in to rescue Drax.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Kraglin flies Knowhere in to rescue.
adds.evidence: Quill tells Kraglin they need his help to save Nebula, Drax and Mantis from the High Evolutionary, and Kraglin pilots Knowhere to Arête and blasts a hole in it.

none.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
none.why: Ayesha only tends to Adam's wound from Nebula's blade; she never meets or contacts Nebula, dealing only with Adam, the High Evolutionary, a Ravager and Gamora by radio.

none.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
none.why: Ayesha's hunt targets Rocket; she never meets or contacts Quill and stays on her ship at Counter-Earth until she dies.

none.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
none.why: Cosmo stays on Knowhere with Kraglin while Drax is on the mission; they share only the group rescue and the closing dance and howl, with no exchange between them.

owner_calls.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
owner_calls.question: This Gamora is the 2014 variant, who does not know Groot as a friend and returns to the Ravagers. Should her Vol. 3 stage with Groot be ally (proposed) or stay friend like the earlier stages with the original Gamora?
owner_calls.evidence: The 2014 Gamora joins the Ravagers and helps the Guardians as an outsider, rescuing Quill and Groot after their leap from Arête.
